scene: Perched atop the disco drone, you arrive at the sky-hub transit platform.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide wooden sky-dock floating high above neon towers. The player sits centre atop the docked disco-ball drone in red jacket and skates. Far left, a giant paper-lantern balloon bobs at a mooring post. Centre, a noodle-cart monorail train waits with open doors. Far right, an open-sided bamboo cable car sways gently.
shown: a giant glowing paper-lantern balloon tethered with its basket open on the far left
a steaming noodle-cart monorail car waiting at the central platform track
a rustic green bamboo cable car dangling from an overhead wire on the far right
